rationale: M60.R8 (#931) — the `App\` root marker, isolated from the explicit import that can stand in for it. `framework-surface-pins` pins both repaired markers but also imports Illuminate, so Laravel is detected there twice over and a revert of the prefix marker would be invisible. This file is the marker's own witness: a controller under Laravel's app root with no framework import anywhere, which is exactly the probe's `laravel-app-root-only` case and the shape the dead marker was written for. MEASURED at HEAD (before the repair): `namespace App\Http\Controllers;` detected `[]` for both this shape and a bare `namespace App;`, while the marker read `text === "App\\"` — an exact match on a namespace string ending in a separator, which no node's text carries. The repair reads the PREFIX the literal was reaching for. The expectation also pins the deliberate EXCLUSION: `namespace App;` alone must not fire (the lane's own literal asked for the `App\` root, not for a project that names one namespace `App`), and PHPUnit must not appear, since nothing here extends `TestCase` — that is the other marker's witness, held in the sibling fixture.

forbidRelationships.comment: no base clause in this file — the framework marker must not become a fabrication source
